description: Build a KYC module for our bank's mobile app: new customers upload an ID document and a selfie, we verify their identity and screen them against sanctions lists before the account is opened.

requirements.statement: The system shall allow new customers to upload an ID document

requirements.statement: The system shall verify the identity of new customers
The system shall screen customers against sanctions lists
The system shall prevent account opening until identity verification and sanctions screening are completed
The system shall store uploaded ID documents and selfies in a secure manner
The system shall ensure personal data collected during KYC is processed in compliance with privacy regulations
The system shall maintain an audit trail of all KYC actions and decisions
The system shall assess money laundering and terrorist financing risks before launching the KYC module in the mobile app.

questions.question:
What happens if the software fails?
   low = Minor inconvenience.
   medium = Noticeable business disruption or recoverable financial loss.
   high = Safety harm, large financial loss, or serious legal/reputational damage.

Is the software subject to binding external regulation or audit?
   low = No specific regulatory obligations.
   medium = General legal obligations apply (e.g., data protection) without software certification.
   high = A named standard or regulator certifies or audits the software (e.g., IEC 62304, DO-178C, PCI DSS).

How large is the effort?
   low = 5 people or fewer.
   medium = 6 to 25 people.
   high = 26 people or more, or many subsystems/teams.

How much formal test and documentation output is required?
   low = Minimal documentation.
   medium = Standard documentation expected but not contractually audited.
   high = Extensive formal deliverables (test reports, design documents, manuals) are acceptance conditions.
